description: This file defines the EntityQuery class used for constructing and executing database entity queries within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for setting query parameters such as select fields, conditions, ordering, and execution options, and includes methods for retrieving query results in various forms.

classes.name: EntityQuery
classes.description: A utility class for building and executing database queries for entities in the OFBiz framework. Supports method chaining for setting query parameters and retrieving results.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EntityQuery instance with a specified Delegator.

methods.name: EntityQuery
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EntityQuery with a given Delegator.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Sets the fields to be selected in the query, replacing any previous selection.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Sets the entity or dynamic view entity to query against.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Sets the WHERE condition for the query, replacing previous conditions.

methods.name: having
methods.description: Sets the HAVING condition for the query.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sets the ORDER BY fields for the query.

methods.name: cursorForwardOnly
methods.description: Sets the cursor type to forward-only.

methods.name: cursorScrollSensitive
methods.description: Sets the cursor type to scroll-sensitive.

methods.name: cursorScrollInsensitive
methods.description: Sets the cursor type to scroll-insensitive.

methods.name: fetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: maxRows
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the query results.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Enables filtering of duplicate results.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Enables or disables cache usage for the query.

methods.name: filterByDate
methods.description: Filters results to only include active records based on date fields.

methods.name: queryList
methods.description: Executes the query and returns a list of results.

methods.name: queryIterator
methods.description: Executes the query and returns an iterator over the results.

methods.name: queryBatchIterator
methods.description: Returns a batch iterator for the query.

methods.name: queryFirst
methods.description: Returns the first result of the query.

methods.name: queryOne
methods.description: Returns a single result, expecting exactly one record.

methods.name: queryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of results matching the query.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of values for a specific entity field.

methods.name: queryPagedList
methods.description: Returns a paged list of results.
